13 // Description: AXI4-Lite to APB4 bridge
14 //
15 // This module has one AXI4-Lite slave port and is capable of generating
16 // APB4 requests for multiple APB4 slave modules. The address and data widths
17 // of AXI4-Lite and APB4 have to be the same for both ports and are enforced over assertions.
18 // The selection of the APB4 slave is handled by the `addr_decode` module from `common_cells`.
19 // This module will answer with a `axi_pkg::RESP_DECERR` when a AXI4-Lite AW or AR request
20 // is not in the address map of the module and `no` APB4 request is made.
21 //
22 // The type of the APB4 request is required to look like:
23 //   typedef struct packed {
24 //     addr_t paddr;   // same as AXI4-Lite
25 //     prot_t pprot;   // same as AXI4-Lite, specification is the same
26 //     logic  psel;    // each APB4 slave has its own single-bit psel
27 //     logic  penable; // enable signal shows second APB4 cycle
28 //     logic  pwrite;  // write enable
29 //     data_t pwdata;  // write data, comes from W channel

299           apb_state_d = Setup;
300           apb_update  = 1'b1;
301         end
302       end
303       default: /* do nothing */ ;
304     endcase
305   end
306 
307   `FFLARN(apb_state_q, apb_state_d, apb_update, Setup, clk_i, rst_ni)
308 
309   // parameter check
310   // pragma translate_off
311   `ifndef VERILATOR
312   initial begin : check_params
313     addr_width:  assert ($bits(axi_lite_req_i.aw.addr ) == $bits(apb_req_o[0].paddr)) else
314       $fatal(1, $sformatf("AXI4-Lite and APB address width not equal"));
315     wdata_width: assert ($bits(axi_lite_req_i.w.data ) == $bits(apb_req_o[0].pwdata)) else
316       $fatal(1, $sformatf("AXI4-Lite and APB write data width not equal"));
317     strb_width:  assert ($bits(axi_lite_req_i.w.strb ) == $bits(apb_req_o[0].pstrb)) else
318       $fatal(1, $sformatf("AXI4-Lite and APB address width not equal"));
319     rdata_width: assert ($bits(axi_lite_resp_o.r.data ) == $bits(apb_resp_i[0].prdata)) else
320       $fatal(1, $sformatf("AXI4-Lite and APB read data width not equal"));
321     sel_width:   assert ($bits(apb_req_o[0].psel) == 32'd1) else
322       $fatal(1, $sformatf("APB psel signal has to have a width of 1'b1"));
323   end
324   `endif
325   // pragma translate_on
326 endmodule
